atoms.b: It was Eliza’s first time out of the climbing gym. Up until now, she only climbed up until ((++50 -50)) feet. Now, out in the mountains, she was faced with more of a challenge. Thankfully, her friend Billy, who had ((++10 -10)) years of climbing experience, offered to join her. While looking down, she estimated that they were about ((++2,500 -2,500)) feet above sea level. Gulp.

instruction.text: Now, read the second part of the text and select which integer expresses each situation.

atoms.text: Eliza knew they still had quite a way up and was feeling slightly de-energised, so she suggested taking a break to have a snack. She knew how important this break was, since rock-climbing takes a lot of energy. Apart from that, she needed to rehydrate since she probably lost at least 1 litre of fluids from all the sweating. After their break, the climbing duo packed their things and ventured on. Shortly before making it to the top, Eliza felt a rock slip away from under her foot. Next thing she knew, she fell about 15 feet before she came to a jerky, awkward halt. Even though she was terrified and her heartbeat increased by 30 beats per minute, she knew her partner wouldn’t let her go.
